protocol: FAA hypobaric chamber evaluation of an oxygen mask in an instrumented participant. The phase 2 flight was planned for 60 minutes at 30,000 ft. The reported case was the accompanying safety observer.
outcome_window: Symptoms were recognized by the time the chamber flight was stopped at 32 minutes on the plateau. Exact symptom onset and delayed follow-up are unavailable.
locator: Phase 2 Methods, printed p. 20 (PDF p. 29) and Phase 2 Results, printed p. 25 (PDF p. 34)
note: Methods describe light bends and Results describe moderate symptoms of bends in the same observer. Diagnostic adjudication, observer breathing gas and workload, and the observer risk-set denominator are unavailable. A decline in blood oxygen saturation to 75% occurred in the instrumented test participant and also contributed to the termination.
